subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain unsupported for Control UI rendering and be rejected or diagnosed clearly?
rationale: The fix changes browser network fetching, CSP, avatar-route auth/privacy behavior, and the public CLI/config avatar contract, so automation should not choose the security policy silently.

options.title: Keep Control UI local/data-only
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and align CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Add same-origin remote proxy
options.body: Support remote avatars only through a gateway-owned fetch/proxy/cache with strict MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and failure-feedback rules.

options.title: Allow direct remote image loads
options.body: Let the browser load configured remote avatar URLs directly, accepting the weaker CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep Control UI local/data-only
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and align CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history across the original avatar feature, Control UI route hardening, and CSP policy surface.
